name: Spatial Photo
description: Drop in one photo and move a camera through it: depth is read on your device, so a flat picture becomes a scene with real parallax, atmosphere and focus.
a11yLabel: Parallax {{default move "dolly-in"}} camera move through a photograph

inputs.label: Photo
inputs.help: Pick a photo or upload your own. Depth is read on your device - the pixels never leave the browser. The export is a fixed 1280 by 720 frame, whatever the picture's own size.

inputs.label: Camera move
inputs.help: Each move is a closed loop, so a video comes back to where it started with no seam.

inputs.label: Amount
inputs.help: How far the camera travels. Each move has its own ceiling: one photo has one layer, so a bigger move than this would smear what should be hidden behind the foreground.

inputs.label: Loop seconds
inputs.help: Seconds for one loop on screen. A video export loops cleanly at any length.

inputs.label: Focus point
inputs.help: Click the canvas to focus there. Everything at that distance stays sharp; the rest falls away.

inputs.label: Depth of field
inputs.help: How hard everything away from the focus point blurs. Zero keeps the whole picture sharp.

inputs.label: Atmosphere
inputs.help: The colour distance washes toward - a brand haze on the far field rather than a generic grey.

inputs.label: Depth contrast
inputs.help: Stretches or flattens the relief the model read. Above 1 exaggerates near and far; below 1 calms a picture the model read too eagerly.
